newsitem.title: UK: Barrow port tug delivered to Assoc British Ports.
newsitem.headline: Barrow port tug delivered to Assoc British Ports.

text.p: Associated British Ports Holdings Plc said on Friday that the Port of Barrow had taken delivery of a new 600,000 pounds sterling multi-purpose harbour vessel.
The tug, Furness Abbey, will be deployed in buoy handling, pilotage, towage and hydrographic surveying and seabed levelling works, the UK ports group said.

Barrow port is on the northern boundary of Morecambe Bay, the location of two British Gas fields which generate around 20 percent of the UK's gas requirements. - Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
